extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, approaching final hearing
extracted.summary: A partner at Danvers Danvers Legal LLP asks whether £27,500 of funding is available for a client's financial remedy case at the Family Court at Manchester, where the only asset is a flat with around £15,000 equity and a final hearing is on 6 September 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Manchester. We have noted the £27,500 requested, the flat with approximately £15,000 of equity, and the final hearing listed for 6 September 2026. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and address, a breakdown of the costs to be funded and any sums already incurred, details of the property including title, ownership and any charges, and confirmation of the other liabilities you mention. Any case documents setting out the asset position, such as Form E or a schedule of assets, would also help. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
